q15.

table: user — `store.User` — `store/user.go:29`
table: attachment — `store.Attachment` — `store/attachment.go:16`
table: reaction — `store.Reaction` — `store/reaction.go:7`

This is the `usememos/memos` codebase. It has no ORM (`TableName()`/struct tags); instead these domain structs in the `store` package are hand-mapped to the SQL tables in driver-specific code, e.g. `store/db/sqlite/user.go` (`INSERT INTO user`, `FROM user`), `store/db/sqlite/attachment.go` (`` INSERT INTO `attachment` ``), and `store/db/sqlite/reaction.go` (`` INSERT INTO `reaction` ``), with equivalent files under `store/db/mysql/` and `store/db/postgres/`.
